1. What happens to the period of a simple pendulum with the increase in altitude? a. increase b. decrease c. Remain constant d. First increases then decreases

2. What will be the value of g on a planet with 80 times less mass and half the radius of the Earth, while the value of g on the Earth’s surface is 9.8 ms-²? a. 0.05 ms-² b. 0.5 ms-² c. 5.0 ms-² d. 5.2 ms-²

3. What would be the value of the acceleration due to gravity on the Earth’s surface if the mass remains constant but the radius of the Earth shrinks by 1%? a. 2% increase b. 1% decrease c. 1% increase d. ½ % decrease
4. Which is the best alternative for the quantity to which the orbital speed of a satellite of mass mmm is proportional? a. m0 b. m c. m1/2 d. m-1/2

5. At what height above the Earth’s surface will the acceleration due to gravity be half the value of g at the surface, given the radius of the Earth as 6400 km? a. 3050 km b. 2650 km c. 3250 km d. 3800 km
6. How deep inside the Earth (of radius RRR) should a man go so that his weight becomes one-fourth of what it is on the Earth’s surface? a. R/4 b. 3R/4 c. 5R/4 d. 5R/2
7. If the distance between the Earth and the sun were half of its present value, what would be the number of days in a year? a. 129 b. 730 c. 182.5 d. 64.5
8. What is the period of a geostationary satellite? a. 12 hour b. 24 hour
